title: Add missing test cases for approvals and DLQ
description:
**Severity: LOW**

**Files**: `core/controlplane/gateway/approvals_test.go`, `core/controlplane/gateway/dlq_test.go`

**Issue**: Missing edge case tests: double-approve idempotency, concurrent approvals, DLQ retry with corrupted metadata, concurrent retries on same job. These are important correctness properties that should be verified.

**Fix**: Add targeted test cases for these scenarios:
- Double-approve: approve the same item twice, verify idempotent behavior
- Concurrent approvals: use goroutines to approve simultaneously, verify no race
- DLQ corrupted metadata: inject bad metadata, verify graceful handling
- Concurrent DLQ retries: retry the same job from multiple goroutines simultaneously

implementationPlan.description: Add `TestApproveJobDoubleApproveIdempotent` to approvals_test.go: approve a job, then approve the same job again. Verify the second call returns 409 Conflict with "job not awaiting approval" since the state moved to `pending` after the first approval.

Add `TestApproveJobConcurrentRace` to approvals_test.go: set up a job in approval state, launch N goroutines (e.g. 10) that all call `handleApproveJob` concurrently. Verify exactly one succeeds (200) and the rest get 409. Use `sync.WaitGroup` and `atomic` counters. Run with `-race`.
Add `TestRetryDLQConcurrent` to dlq_test.go: add a DLQ entry with context, launch N goroutines that all call `handleRetryDLQ` concurrently. Verify no panics or data races. Use `-race` flag.

Add `TestRetryDLQMissingContext` to dlq_test.go: add a DLQ entry but don't set up the context payload in memStore. Call `handleRetryDLQ` and verify it returns a graceful error (not a panic or 500 with unhelpful message).
Run `go test -race -count=3 ./core/controlplane/gateway/...` to verify all tests pass without races.
